After changing motion, clears specialn_kp.x0[0], x0[3], x14 and x18; stores Item_8026AE60() in x0[1]; writes -1 to prior graphics selector x0[2]; and sets x10 to 1. Subsequent callbacks use x0[0] for emission cadence, x0[3] for the B-check threshold, x10 for continuation, x14 for emission-phase bookkeeping and x18 for quake timing.

facts.rationale: Corrects the blanket phase-symmetry claim and preserves release timing and post-transition bookkeeping.
facts.value: The copied move has ground and air startup, sustained and ending callbacks with Kp/Gk destination selection. Startup animation completion enters sustained states. Sustained IASA delays release checking until an elapsed threshold, emits on cadence while B is held or x10 remains nonzero, otherwise enters ending, and still runs its cadence/depletion tail after that transition. Ending animations delegate to common grounded completion or Fall. Collision transitions preserve the current animation frame; active transitions use 0x0C4C5880 and startup/ending transitions use 0x0C4C5080. Aerial startup landing is exceptional: it enters grounded sustained KpSpecialN/GkSpecialN, not grounded startup.
